summary: Oyatie-owned Redis vocabulary was rewritten to Valkey per ADR-0336; counterpart/customer Redis facts were preserved with explicit annotations.

verification.command: for ms in workflow-engine workflow-studio data-pipeline data-warehouse analytics intelligence translate feature-flags tasks application; do rg -i 'redis' microservices/$ms/ | grep -v -E 'REMEDIATION-NOTES|counterpart-fact|historical|from-redis-on-aws|external-redis|customer.redis|legacy.redis' | wc -l; done
for ms in workflow-engine workflow-studio data-pipeline data-warehouse analytics intelligence translate feature-flags tasks application; do rg -c 'Valkey' microservices/$ms/; done
verification.result: Valkey present in all 10 assigned microservices

verification.command: ruby -ryaml YAML.load_file on changed catalog and Valkey Helm YAML files

remaining_risks: A broad git diff --check over all assigned microservices still reports pre-existing blank EOF findings in analytics/application/translate compliance files; they were not part of the Valkey rewrite surface.

findings: The migration is a naming and doctrine alignment pass; it avoids new abstractions and keeps upstream protocol/client compatibility intact.
Valkey aligns the assigned microservice corpus with ADR-0336 and hyperscaler-managed Valkey substrate posture.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: residual grep filter must return 0 for all assigned services
findings: Residual Redis checks passed after excluding explicit counterpart-fact and external-redis preservations.
Catalog, manifest, IaC, runbook, and remediation-note names now use Valkey consistently in the assigned bucket.
JSON parse checks, YAML parse checks for strict catalog/Helm files, residual grep, Valkey presence, and path residue checks passed.

alternatives_named: Preserve all Redis strings as historical
Rewrite only Oyatie-owned substrate references and annotate counterpart facts
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: ADR-0336 requires Oyatie-owned substrate vocabulary to move to Valkey while preserving factual counterpart/customer Redis references.
rejected_reasons: Blanket rewrite would falsify n8n and connector-catalog facts.
Preserving all Redis strings would leave Oyatie-owned substrate residue.

findings: No credentials or runtime secrets were introduced; REDIS-style env and secret names in the assigned surface were renamed to VALKEY-style names.

policy_facets.A1_naming: adapter-valkey, valkey env refs, Valkey runbooks, and Valkey IaC paths are now used in assigned services.
policy_facets.A2_documentation: Each assigned microservice has a Wave 15-Valkey remediation-note block.
